notes.title: Dungeon Munchies is an RPG platformer where you're a zombie, and worse, an unpaid intern
notes.content: Sometimes, a whole game sprouts from a tiny seed of an idea. In the case of Dungeon Munchies, it's a simple, jokey premise: you're an unpaid zombie intern. A necromancer-chef named Simmer raises you as part of her plan to unleash a new generation of magical cuisine on the world. Why? How? You're not being paid enough to ask those questions, because you're not being paid at all. So off you go, searching the dungeon for ingredients. Don't worry about dying: endless, inescapable revival is part of your employee benefits package... Read more.

notes.title: Dungeon Munchies launches out of Early Access on July 28!
notes.content:
Hi, all! I'm Scofa and it's been a while, hasn't it.

Good news: We're still alive.

[h3]Better News: Dungeon Munchies will officially be released on July 28![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/597be9be1efac1372750ea6601eaea6fa26bcd1d.jpg[/img]

For new people, Dungeon Munchies is a side-scrolling platformer where you hunt, cook, and eat monsters to gain their powers! You are a hungry, hungry zombie finding your way (and yourself) as you traverse through a vast underground city.

Fill up and suit up to secure your place at the top of the food chain!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/dc481e50c4bcedfadc01bb01c5735a169db2c57f.gif[/img]

Got the munchies? Throw those bits and pieces together and make yourself a feast!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/6e8faaadf8167ee7504cca64d2ba9327a9c1ce00.gif[/img]


[h2]How will the official release differ from the Early Access versions?[/h2]

Once Dungeon Munchies leaves Early Access, it will have all the content in the Early Access plus:

[h3]New enemies![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/a116fce40f7189f44e3e530f67153feaaa05314d.gif[/img]


[h3]The greatest weapons ever made![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/dbc819a000a98cd0c7d53a085ef371c9cf0fd2af.gif[/img]


[h3]Cooking with friends! (They'll make you do all the work) [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/2b3f25aabdf756a179cfb462104cb2ddda5e6bca.gif[/img]

[h3]New Languages![/h3]
Japanese, Korean, Spanish, and German!

[h3]The End...[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/99d67d8c6667d3932bed11bc7f6976b04764e54b.jpg[/img]
Continuing from where we left off in Chapter Two, this last update will reveal the final fate of you and your friends!

[h3]Price[/h3]
Another important difference will be PRICE! Once it releases on July 28, we will raise the game's price to reflect its completed state. If you were on the wall about Dungeon Munchies, grab it now to secure that delicious early access price!

==========================

I want to say "thank you" to everyone once more.
During development, we experienced excitement, pain, fatigue, and joy.
Without your feedback, reviews, memes, art, and support, we wouldn't be here.
Thank you to all who have helped us complete this wild game.
I hope you'll all enjoy the official release of Dungeon Munchies.
See you on July 28!

- Scofa

[Open Beta] 0.3.1.26
1. Fixed game startup issue for some machines.
2. Fixed issue involving errors when enemies are killed.

1. Fixed Toxic Tempest not being triggered by Bat Soup, Fried Leg Tenders, etc.
2. English error text is now displayed when dialogue is missing.
3. Fixed Tentacle-Stir fry activating without a weapon.
4. Various other bug fixes.

[Open Beta] 0.3.1.43

In this update, we greatly optimized the game's code. Players previously stuck at the main menu should try opening the game again to see if it still occurs.

1. Re-organized images, reduced portrait image sizes.
2. Removed outdated, unused assets.
3. Changed asset loading times. Assets are now loaded when used, not loaded all at once.
4. Fixed lag caused by Portable Turret
5. Fixed a bug where certain sounds could not be controlled by the game's volume sliders.
6. Fixed players getting stuck on a wall and dying during Grill's escort mission.

We made some pretty fundamental changes, so please report any errors and graphical glitches you encounter. We'll try to fix them as soon as possible.

1. Fixed double jump at game start bug.
2. Fixed a bug that blocked skipping already-read dialogue.
3. Fixed a bug that caused the Blood Lotus description to disappear.

1. Fixed graphical errors in a few levels
2. Clam Tonic blasts now activate during spear attacks and Spear Flurry.
3. Improved Bat Soup infection speed.
4. Raised base maximum mana and mana recovery rate for staves.
5. Reduced Ice Shield exhaust rate
6. Added visual effects to the Flaming Halberd and Toxic Tempest.
7. Fixed Toxic Tempest graphical glitches when inflicting damage.
8. Fixed Bow & Arrow angle inaccuracy issue.
9. Fixed a bug where the Sweaty Sports Drink did not have any effect.
10. White icons will no longer appear when opening the Chpt. 3 weapons menu.

notes.title: Monthly Devlog #10 - Delays
notes.content:
Hello! Rising from the ashes of illness, self-doubt and self-sabotage, it's Scofa.
A few months ago, I was on the verge of a mental/physical breakdown due to my living and work habits. My colleagues saw that and forced me to drop everything and take a break. That's the reason behind the lack of updates recently. Because of that delay, we also won't be able to release the next update,(originally scheduled for this summer) on time. 

Our sincere apologies to everyone waiting patiently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/2f0f00c3f16031bfd9608b639d5c39a85b91dd7e.png[/img]
[i]"Where's my Chapter Two, huh? Answer me, Simmer! When do I get to show up?"
"I-its almost done!"[/i]


I've completely recovered and returned to work. We're all wrapping up development for Chapter Two. I want players to be able to experience it as soon as possible.

We've reached the final stages of development. All new weapons, food, levels, enemies and bosses are complete. Our programmer is spending most of his time testing and fixing bugs. 
We have a new person on the team dedicated to music and SFX. We look forward to sharing the workload and a better audio experience for this chapter.
I've recently been refining the dialogue and drawing character portraits and animations.
Like I said: I-it's almost done!


Here's some shiny new content I can show off:
[u]Phantom Barrage[/u]
In this type of sword-based build, once you activate a complicated combo, you will enter a state of zen, cutting apart all the enemies around you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/a84043718c7e52aa97b6eaa6a10c6e96f499d5df.gif[/img]

[u]Upgrade your Food[/u]
Those barely-useful "Insight" points can now be used to upgrade food. Dishes that seem useless can be upgraded to grant ridiculous stat boosts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/fc41c3496f11a8430f1a8b71ccc0e39e25013cff.gif[/img]


Thank you for your patience and please don't worry. I will not collapse before completing this game.
The next thing you hear from us will be our release announcement for Chapter 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/b21f56154d6919cd7186e610eb7d157af088a768.png[/img]
See you then!

------------------------------------------------






Before getting into Dungeon Munchies, I only knew how to do lewd drawings and dumb, random comics. Doing an actual script with a real plot was a new challenge for me.

notes.title: Monthly Devlog #6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/c5ab224eaed8224924ddf15b3339611346de7ee7.png[/img]

Hi, this is Scofa with the newest episode of the hit series "Dungeon Munchies Devlog".

This is the new boss we've been working on: Fruit Salad.
It's very nutritious and rich in dietary fiber, a fundamental part of the modern diet.
We used the most natural, organic, and environmentally-friendly means to create this boss. No chemical pesticides or herbicides were used during development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/1cfca438d1ba4a84be5d4a6e9212bdce7cd2fd67.gif[/img]

With the new framework, we could finally use some proper tools to add content to the game.
While reviewing our older framework, we decided to overhaul something that we [strike]just kinda glossed over[/strike] thought could have been implemented better: [u]weapons[/u].


[b]Overhaul of Magic Weapons[/b]

Staff-type weapons will now be primary weapons and using them will expend Mana of some kind. The damage output of these weapons will also be increased.

What is Mana, you ask? It's a whole new system for magical weapons we added that, uh, does what you would expect it to do. Like in many other games, once the blue mana bar runs out, you won't be able to cast magic. You can use it slowly and carefully, or blow it all in one massive attack. To recharge mana, simply hold down the attack button to absorb all the magic that's in the air.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/78cfd040fc5e016b24556244aae631595f0e1c70.gif[/img]

With a certain secondary weapon that passively recovers mana, the Staff of Explosions can do much more damage to this crop of pineapples.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/8f40b4d4d61c9b8ef48aceb77240c08695bffbb9.gif[/img]

We'll also have more foods dedicated to magic weapons so we hope players will incorporate them into their [strike]builds[/strike] diets.


[b]Scythe Overhaul[/b]

We've changed how the skeletons are summoned. Once equipped, nearby dead enemies turn into trapped spirits. Once the scythe is used to harvest them, they become our little helper skeletons.
Once you employ too many skeletons, additional harvested spirits are liquidated and distributed among your existing workforce, adding to their health and attack etc.

As with magical weapons, we'll be serving more foods that enhance summoning in the next chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/313e6c536fb85938532dd3f3fa8f04b92ef737a7.gif[/img]


[b]New Dishes[/b]

Many of the new dishes have been [strike]plagiarized from[/strike] inspired by input from the community. Translations are tentative.

[u]Grilled Corn on the Cob[/u]
Unleash a special attack when using Attack + Dash with a spear-type weapon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/e6527f2b671f103ec3dda874d944962edd4a86d8.gif[/img]

[u]Tomato & Beef Noodle Soup[/u]
Axe attacks give you a layer of lycopene. 30 layers let's you do this whirlwind attack:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/12c34f68a9a7ac747fd7b96b9ad6b9b19541372a.gif[/img]

[u]Stir-fried Broccoli[/u]
Holding a fully-drawn bow for just a bit longer enables you to shoot an arrow that flies straight and ignores gravity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/ad40e6035b40354dd4aa4275f0a45683e5ccd56a.gif[/img]

[u]Grandma's Fruit Preserves[/u]
Using Attack + Dash with daggers adds a "decomposition" effect to your enemies. The effect amplifies poison and bleed damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/210eb14668978934fea1e20023f385a351eb4d7d.gif[/img]

That's all we have for today. We'll continue adding fun dishes to the game.

Once again, if you're in the neighborhood next month, come check us out at Taipei Game Show (Feb. 6-Feb. 9) where we'll be showing some of the new content.

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Monthly Devlog #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/3f5e30291e80fb8e2dc5e9c091586bd37bc6d917.gif[/img]
[i]"Grill is dead. We can't let her sacrifice be in vain."
*Puts her on the grill.*
"Remember what she said before she died..."
[/i]
Hi, this is Scofa with the newest news in Dungeon Munchies development.

This month's programming has burnt us all down to a crisp. We encountered a lot of issues when adding content and new features to the game. That's because the old framework of the game was designed when we were (slightly) younger and had its share of issues and inefficiencies. 

This month, we spent a lot of time reworking that framework so we could work more efficiently. It's nothing flashy but it's a big change and we were able to fix many long-standing issues we've been having. This should allow us to work on the content more smoothly!

We plan to release the next chapter in the summer of 2020!

The next chapter will not only advance the story, but will [u]almost double[/u] the number of levels, bosses, equipment and food in the game. We want it to be just as good, if not better than the release of the first chapter, so development time has taken longer than we expected. 

To everyone who's following our progress, thank you for your patience, your support has been very dear and important to us.

If you want to follow our progress a little more closely, we will be at [u]Taipei Game Show (Feb. 6-Feb. 9)[/u] next year with [b]all new stages to play[/b]. Remember to mark your calendars and book your flights, [i]or else[/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/52ed060e8720f56dc26f937083a17fd7d8214125.png[/img]

We've redone the weapon system, which will allow us to create more tools to bring peace and prosperity across the dungeon. Here are a few we can show off right now:

[b]New Spear[/b]
Nobody knows how to use this ancient weapon anymore. Sometimes, it does something unexpected. Maybe it's been enchanted or blessed!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/64b6eee6ebe24f67f62874681b3385e12b03f070.gif[/img]

[b]New Axe[/b]
Like the New Spear, it's an ancient weapon. Its instructions have been lost.
Perhaps a special individual will be able to unlock its true potential.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/4c3738152c7694edf2e4d68da59f84abaed5a8c7.gif[/img]


[b]Chili Gun[/b]
A weapon made, in a very inhumane manner, from the chili people. One of it's features is the ability to charge and fire a larger, spicier fireball. What's not a feature is the fireball floating upwards. That's a bug. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/a42b8b12855f63ae35b4a632a1661625dfd46dcb.gif[/img]


[b]Dark Flame Sword[/b]
Charges up and shoots a slow-moving dark fireball.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/20fdddb2a9b3199e72668ba360f5bd833cc08474.gif[/img]

[b]Laser Sub-machine Gun[/b]
This gun shoots lasers but uses up electricity quickly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/023890a7c914e530b45ccd7379c4fef55091490a.gif[/img]

[b]Dark Moon[/b]
It's a good sword, but because the scabbard was designed poorly, a lot of effort is needed to take it out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/f30c835f579daa77a4ce4e0a95319bb079142177.gif[/img]

[b]Staff of Confusion[/b]
A simple law enforcement device issued by the government.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/3861ebb8df4465f06ca0c903aca3beb0d2ff4f8d.gif[/img]

[b]Grappling Leech[/b]
Throw one of these at enemies and pull them closer to you. Most effective against aerial targets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/83c8b6ee7672e096ba97b607ebc6bed543142539.gif[/img]

[b]That's it and thanks for reading! [/b]

notes.title: Monthly Devlog #4
notes.content:
Hi, this is Scofa and I've brought another devlog for this past month.
Let's take a closer look at the exciting new ecosystems we have.
(Major spoilers are omitted, but still, minor spoilers ahead.)

------------------------------------------------------

It's a friendly neighborhood broccoli, practicing their traditional sport of archery. What a unique cultural display.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/d0837bf677b775c24b3e70326dc3196dbd79eba1.gif[/img]

Let's greet him with our flaming green dragon sword!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/203ab55bca377ce0b2d4a61a4678bd3a99cf9d84.gif[/img]
Our passion seems to have scared it into oblivion. We should always take care to learn about cultural differences so that we can prevent mistakes like this.

Moving on to the tomato farms, we see energetic tomato people frolicking with their battle axes. They seem to be practicing for something.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/aa03bc6691a32d18b4ef8855fcd851394f96ab79.gif[/img]

The corn people look like they want to join in.

In the confusion, our apprentice seems to have hit them in the head with a hammer and given them concussions. We should leave before they charge us with assault and make us pay for their fraudulent medical claims.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/4c3f2445d8e667a4fbb53522d0caa71ab89770e3.gif[/img]

It's always a nice surprise to see a rare wendigo in the wild. Ever since their main source of food, humans, died out, their numbers have decreased rapidly. Wendigos are listed as "Critically Endangered" on the Lord of the Forest's Endangered Species List.

We'll deliver updates as we continue to work, full speed, towards the next chapter.

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: Dungeon Munchies
notes.content:
Premature Evaluation is the weekly column in which Steve Hogarty explores the wilds of early access. This week Steve has been playing Dungeon Munchies, but has also been sidetracked by that factoid about eating spiders in your sleep.

Developer: maJAJa
Publisher: maJAJa

Release: Out now (early access)
On: Windows, Mac OSX
From: Steam
For: 11, $14, 11.59

A friend of mine works for an insect farm, raising crickets and fly larvae as an alternative protein source for livestock feed, as well as for human snacks. His job is to distract each cricket for just long enough so that a colleague can swoop in from behind and humanely murder the cricket with a tiny hammer. Or at least that s how I understood it. I wasn t paying much attention, as my mind was racing with the culinary potential of mashed insects, pureed slugs and fried spiders. I don t eat meat, but I m almost certain that spiders aren t actually real animals to begin with. Certainly not animals with any meat in them. They re probably more closely related to robots, or angry coins, so whatever.
